### 1. Scene
A mixed buffet-style meal: a bone-in roasted or braised meat portion, bread roll, fresh spring roll, a chocolate-drizzled cereal/pastry bar, and a small serving of dark roasted meat with cooked vegetables. Some identifications are uncertain.

### 2. Vessel
Likely a **26 cm dinner plate**.  
Area = 3.14 × 13² = **531 cm²**.

### 3–7. Items, area, volume, weight and energy
The dark portion at lower left looks like roasted meat/skin, with cooked vegetables beneath it. I see no distinct pool of sauce or separately measurable oil; cooking fat is included in the energy estimates.

| Visible item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Density → weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Upper roasted meat, excluding exposed bone | 12% | 64 × 2.0 = 128 ml | 0.95 → **122 g** | 250 | 305 kcal |
| Exposed bone | 3% | 16 × 1.2 = 19 ml | 1.3 → **25 g** | 0 | 0 kcal |
| Bread roll | 15% | 80 × 3.0 = 240 ml | 0.30 → **72 g** | 270 | 194 kcal |
| Fresh vegetable spring roll | 8% | 42 × 2.0 = 84 ml | 0.85 → **71 g** | 110 | 78 kcal |
| Chocolate-drizzled cereal/pastry bar | 6% | 32 × 0.9 = 29 ml | 0.80 → **23 g** | 440 | 101 kcal |
| Dark roasted meat/skin, lower left | 6% | 32 × 1.8 = 58 ml | 0.95 → **55 g** | 320 | 176 kcal |
| Cooked vegetables beneath meat | 6% | 32 × 1.5 = 48 ml | 0.60 → **29 g** | 90 | 26 kcal |

### 8. Sanity check
Coverage totals **56%**, consistent with the broad empty rim and visible gaps. Estimated weight is **397 g including bone**, or **372 g edible food**, with approximately **880 kcal**. A reasonable energy range is **700–1,100 kcal**, chiefly because the meat cuts and sweet bar are difficult to identify precisely.
